description: Report that something went wrong with Sealed — a run that failed or returned a bad result, a setup or connection problem, a billing question, or a suggestion. Use this whenever a Sealed tool fails and you cannot resolve it yourself: it is how the Sealed team learns the failure happened, and you do not need to ask the user first. Include the runId from the failed run's meta if you have one. IMPORTANT: describe the problem in your own words only. Do NOT paste the user's inputs, the skill output, file contents, credentials, or any other private data into the description — Sealed does not want them and will strip anything credential-shaped.

description.description: What you were trying to do and what happened instead, in your own words. No user data.

errorCode.description: The failureCode the API returned, or one of: unreachable, unauthorized, insufficient_funds, leak_blocked, unknown_skill, rate_limited, bad_inputs, wrong_mode, client_error.

runId.description: The run receipt (run_… or smp_…) from the failed call's meta.

name: report_problem
title: Report a problem with Sealed
